biomethane_support_conversion.calculation: candidate biomethane kg/year ÷ density × average value per Nm3; candidate-specific annual volume is used, with no feed-yield proxy
biomethane_support_conversion.standard_conditions: Nm3 at 0 degC and 101.325 kPa; biomethane treated as methane for mass-volume conversion
biomethane_support_conversion.caveat: Screening overlay only; actual SDE++ support depends on eligible biomethane injection and annual correction amounts.

financial_basis.performance_improvements: None: original modeled sales and OPEX; no assumed cost reductions or revenue/yield uplifts.
financial_basis.capex_basis: high direct uninstalled equipment CAPEX from current cost register; digester tank at €1,800/m3
financial_basis.operating_premium_basis: Dynamic per-candidate biomethane output (annual biomethane kg divided by 0.716 kg/Nm3 at 0 degC and 101.325 kPa) multiplied by the average user-specified value of €1.87/Nm3; nominal support applied for 15 years. This is a scenario proxy, not an official SDE++ award calculation; sensitivity range €1.28–€2.46/Nm3 is retained for later analysis.
financial_basis.npv_basis: After-tax constant-account screening NPV using Configure defaults; no financing, escalation, replacement, working capital, residual value or installed-CAPEX factor unless explicitly entered.

carbon_basis.net_carbon_definition: Operational climate load × 12/44 minus retained product carbon, t C/year.
carbon_basis.fiber_fate: 100% of modeled press-cake carbon assumed in furniture over 20 years; manufacturing loss and end-of-life excluded.
carbon_basis.soil_fate: 10% of modeled nutrient-rich-solids carbon retained in soil as an explicit screening assumption.
carbon_basis.protein_carbon_credit: none; protein may be fed or used as biostimulant and no split/retention rate is specified.
excluded: downstream product use except stated product-carbon stock

exclusions.materials: Upstream material production is outside this factory-operational boundary; no zero-burden claim.
exclusions.transport: Offsite feedstock and product transport is excluded.
exclusions.storage_emissions: Storage emissions are excluded from this operational boundary; separate storage modelling is not characterized here.
exclusions.feedstock_production: Cultivation and land-use change are excluded.

electricity.note: Modeled annual electricity activity; Dutch average factor and stated sensitivity applied.

heat.note: Modeled annual process heat activity; user-supplied Dutch heat-network average applied.

process_emissions.note: Modeled vented process methane and gas flows; terminal gas fate set to emitted for this screening case.

limitations: C30/C45/C60/C0 CAPEX grant fractions are user-defined what-if values, not awards or verified RVO eligibility determinations.

The OPEX overlay multiplies each candidate's modeled biomethane volume by the average €1.87/Nm3 value; €1.28–€2.46/Nm3 is retained as a later sensitivity range. This is not a verified RVO tariff or guaranteed support.
RVO DEI+ eligibility, eligible cost base, grant ceiling and co-funding conditions are not assessed.
RVO SDE++ support is modeled from each candidate's biomethane output for 15 years without official annual market corrections or an eligibility test.
CAPEX is high direct uninstalled screening cost; installation and unpriced/uncosted components may be missing.
OPEX remains partial; NPV is a pre-tax screening calculation, not the model financial NPV.
Operational climate inventory is limited to electricity, heat, and modeled process emissions at the stated factors.
Net carbon includes assumed furniture and soil carbon retention; no manufacturing loss or end-of-life release is represented.
The fronts are bounded by the sampled configurations and are not global optima.
